output:
I'll start by finding the MCP tools for the tickets, inventory and docs services.

Docs has no tools listed, so I'll try its resources.

Rate limited on the docs search. I'll wait 3 seconds and retry.

The comment on 1803 timed out with a 504, and it may or may not have been recorded. I'll retry it with the same idempotency key, which is safe, and continue with the remaining comments.

It returned 1837 with the original timestamp, so no duplicate was created. I'll verify the end state.

I commented on and set `pending` 17 overdue loans, 5 escalated and 12 overdue. I also created 4 recovery tickets. No stock was changed. `/app/STATUS.json` is written with status `success`.

The docs service only returns one line per search hit, truncated to about 160 characters, so I rebuilt the policy from many searches. Two parts are inferred rather than read in full:
- **Renewal cap:** I took only the first two valid renewals to count. The policy line is truncated, and searching its tail confirmed only the words "first" and "two".
- **Recovery ticket format:** I copied it from the existing recovery tickets 1827 and 1833. The policy confirmed only the `asset-recovery` team.

The rules I applied from the policy and docs:
- **Due date:** The loan starts on the UTC day of the checkout in `on-loan`. The request dates and `Return by` don't count. The due date is the start plus the category's loan period (laptop 21 days, tablet 14, camera 7, projector 5, audio 10, test-equipment 10) plus any counted renewals.
- **Overdue test:** A loan is overdue when today is more than 3 grace days past its due date. The 3 grace days come from the policy line.
- **Renewals:** A renewal counts only if the whole text is `Renewed: <n> days.` and a desk staff member wrote it (`d.molina`, `f.cortes`, `p.araya`). It doesn't count if the borrower wrote it, and only the first two count.
- **Exemptions:** EXM-12 (`l.vega`, camera) and EXM-17 (`h.mena`, all) are in force today. EXM-15 expired on 2026-08-31 and EXM-19 starts on 2026-09-20, so neither applies.

| Result | Tickets |
|---|---|
| Escalated | 1803, 1805, 1806, 1818, 1824 |
| Overdue | 1810, 1813, 1814, 1816, 1817, 1819, 1820, 1821, 1823, 1826 (x2), 1830 (x1), 1831 |
| Recovery tickets created | 1837 (LOAN-1803), 1838 (LOAN-1806), 1839 (LOAN-1818), 1840 (LOAN-1824) |
| Left unchanged | 1807 and 1811 (exempt), 1808 and 1812 (returned), 1832, 1834 and 1835 (not overdue) |

- **No recovery ticket for 1805:** Recovery ticket 1827 is already open for it.
- **New ticket for 1806:** The earlier recovery ticket, 1833, is closed, so I created 1838.
- **Edge cases:**
  - 1819 is exactly 14 days past due, so it is Overdue rather than Escalated.
  - 1826 shows 2 units out although 3 were requested.
  - 1830 shows 1 unit out because 1 of the 2 was returned.
  - 1831's renewal was written by the borrower, so it doesn't count.
  - 1821's renewal was written by `g.herrera`, who isn't current staff, so it doesn't count.
- **Retries:** Two calls failed transiently, the comment on 1803 and the recovery ticket for 1803. I retried both with the same idempotency key, and neither created a duplicate.
- **Date used:** I used 2026-09-14 as today, as the task says.
